business_problem: Vodafone wanted to improve customer experience for complex service interactions by making its virtual assistant better at understanding nuanced enquiries and by reducing repetitive work for care agents so they could resolve harder issues faster without passing customers around.
solution_summary: Vodafone built two customer-care AI services, SuperTOBi and SuperAgent, as part of its customer experience programme using Microsoft’s generative AI stack. SuperTOBi extends Vodafone’s existing TOBi virtual assistant with Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service so it can interpret more complex customer enquiries, respond in a more natural way, and personalize responses across Vodafone’s multilingual service footprint. When TOBi cannot resolve an issue, it hands the interaction to a human agent together with a conversation summary, preserving context for the next step. SuperAgent then supports the agent by locating detailed answers from Vodafone’s knowledge base and by checking call and online chat transcripts to identify missing information or training needs. Vodafone also says both solutions operate under its AI Framework, which governs ethical, unbiased, explainable AI use as rollout expands across call centres and markets.

solution_components.name: SuperTOBi
solution_components.role: Vodafone’s GenAI-enhanced virtual assistant handles customer enquiries, personalizes responses, and escalates unresolved issues with context to a human agent.

solution_components.name: SuperAgent
solution_components.role: Agent-assist service helps customer care employees find the right information quickly and handle more complex or cross-domain queries.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service
solution_components.role: Provides the generative AI capabilities that improve TOBi’s understanding and response quality for complex enquiries.

solution_components.name: Vodafone-wide knowledge database
solution_components.role: Supplies the detailed internal information that SuperAgent searches to answer technical and service questions.

solution_components.name: AI Framework
solution_components.role: Provides governance for ethical, unbiased, and explainable use of AI and machine learning in the customer experience solutions.

data_flow: Customer questions enter SuperTOBi, which uses Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service to interpret and answer them in natural language. If the bot cannot resolve an issue, it passes a summary of the conversation to a human agent. SuperAgent then retrieves relevant material from the Vodafone-wide knowledge database and checks call or online chat transcripts so the agent can resolve the case faster and with more context.
business_outcome: Vodafone reports better first-time resolution for complex enquiries, shorter customer call times, improved response accuracy and customer satisfaction, less repetitive work for agents, broader employee skills, and the ability to reuse the approach across multiple markets.
